---
title: "07 - BANKSY sweep"
subtitle: "Every BANKSY settings row on every biopsy"
---

```{r}
source("_helpers.R")
source("_figures.R")
sw_f <- find_tab("^banksy_sweep_summary\\.csv$")
sw <- read_files(sw_f, colClasses = c(lambda = "character", res = "character"))
```

The optional `banksy_sweep` stage runs each biopsy through every row of `banksy_variants` and scores the niches each row makes, so the spatial stage's `banksy_settings` row can be chosen on evidence.

```{r}
page_top(
  stages = "banksy_sweep",
  Input = "The spatial object's cells, per biopsy.",
  Method = "BANKSY with each row of <code>banksy_variants</code>, scored by agreement with the FOVs and the cell types, coherence and niche counts.",
  Output = "The tables in <code>tables/07_spatial/banksy_sweep</code>."
)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(render_tree(list(
  "Scores per settings row" = function() {
    if (is.null(sw)) return(missing_note("No sweep in this run. The banksy_sweep stage runs one."))
    fig <- rfig("sweep_ari", sw_f, function() {
      d <- copy(sw)[, setting := paste0("lambda ", lambda, ", res ", res)]
      ggplot(d, aes(ari_vs_fov, ari_vs_celltype, colour = variant)) +
        geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.85) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = sample_colours(sort(unique(d$variant))), name = NULL) +
        facet_wrap(~setting) +
        labs(x = "Agreement with the FOVs (ARI), lower is better", y = "Agreement with the cell types (ARI)") +
        theme_report()
    }, 10, 6)
    tagList(
      rgallery(list(`Each row's niches against the FOVs and the cell types, one point per biopsy` = fig), big = TRUE),
      tab("^banksy_sweep_summary\\.csv$", colClasses = c(lambda = "character", res = "character")),
      csv_links(find_tab("^banksy_sweep_(metrics|times)\\.csv$"))
    )
  },
  "Maps" = function() {
    f <- figs("07_spatial/banksy_sweep", "_map_.+\\.png$", FALSE)
    figure_picker(f, nice(f, "banksy_sweep_map_"), empty = "No sweep maps.")
  },
  ".pipeline" = function() pipeline_figures(figs("07_spatial/banksy_sweep", "\\.png$", FALSE)),
  "Parameters" = function() {
    if (!file.exists(res_path("pipeline_info", "banksy_sweep_params.json"))) return(missing_note("The sweep has not run."))
    params_table(c("banksy_sweep_samples", "banksy_sweep_map_res", "banksy_sweep_focal"), "banksy_sweep")
  }
)))
```
